## Projects

### Search Metric Analyzer (SMA)

A multi-agent diagnostic system that automates the hardest parts of search metric investigation. Four-stage pipeline — Understand, Hypothesize, Dispatch, Synthesize — with parallel sub-agents investigating each hypothesis against a routed knowledge base (playbooks, SEV archive, metric registry, domain digests, corrections index, schema catalog). Architecture is a hybrid: skill as interface, Python scripts as backbone. Prompts drive reasoning; code enforces 14 quality gates (C1–C14).

Live demo: https://search-metric-analyzer-demo.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/surahli123/search-metric-analyzer
Tech: Python, DuckDB, PyYAML

### SMA v2 — Meta-SMA self-improvement loop

Newer iteration that closes a feedback loop on itself. Every investigation writes to a run registry. Retrospectives identify failure patterns. Auto-generated learnings inject back into the next run's context. 788 tests, 12 golden scenarios, regression gate in CI.

### AutoRefine

Eval-grounded skill improvement loop combining Karpathy's autoresearch with Hamel's Three Gulfs. Turns prompt-tweaking into a disciplined research pipeline — error analysis, judge validation, mutation loop.

Source: https://github.com/surahli123/autorefine-skill-improvement

### Water Bottle Finance Analyzer

Enterprise finance analysis for a Chinese company's CEO. Built primarily with OpenAI Codex. Bilingual (EN/中文), privacy guardrails, real users.

Live demo: https://static-kit.vercel.app/demo/fuguang-agent-dashboard-v1.html?lang=en&view=dashboard&state=normal

### DS Productivity Agents

Plugin system for data science workflows — specialized skills for DS review and search domain knowledge, with a built-in eval framework.

Source: https://github.com/surahli123/ds-productivity-agents
